behaviors.description: Show configured remote details after a metadata change.
behaviors.preconditions: Two named remotes have independently selected titles and distinct URLs.
behaviors.expected: Details equal columns=all and differ from ordinary output; exact names, titles and URLs persist in two rows before and after changing one title.

mappings.rationale: Independent remote properties back the alias comparison, with a changed-title control against stale output.

surface_assertions.rationale: Detailed rows expose independently supplied URLs and changing titles while matching the documented all-columns output.
